description.text: The sixth expansion of the Sun & Moon series, released on 2 March 2018. Ultra Necrozma-GX, Necrozma's final form, does more damage with its attack Photon Geyser the more basic Psychic Energy it discards. The set brought many Pokémon and Trainers of the Kalos region, among them Xerneas-GX, Yveltal-GX, Zygarde-GX and Greninja-GX, with Prism Star Volcanion, Diancie and Lysandre. Packs held five cards, and each box of 30 held one card of Super Rare or higher. The cards are numbered to 94, followed by full-art Super Rare Pokémon-GX, Lady, Diantha and Bonnie, rainbow Hyper Rare Pokémon-GX, and gold Ultra Rare Eneporter, Mysterious Treasure and Unit Energy. In English most of its cards came out in Forbidden Light in May 2018.
